Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 29-Dec-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  FIFTH SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE, MAKEUP EXAMINATIONS - DECEMBER 2025  
  Digital Forensics [IT_3129]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                     Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                Describe the major challenges investigators face in computer crime investigations. Illustrate with      (5)  
  one real-life case study.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Remember"  
  
  B)           During an identity theft investigation, a suspect's laptop and smartphone are seized. Explain the       (5)  
  main computer forensics techniques that can be applied to uncover evidence of the crime.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
2)                Describe the key roles and responsibilities of a skilled Incident Response (IR) team in managing        (5)  
  and mitigating security incidents.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)           A company reports unauthorized access to its confidential files. As a forensic investigator, illustrate (5)  
  the key steps involved in the data acquisition process to ensure digital evidence is accurately  
  captured and preserved for analysis.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
3)                While investigating a system intrusion, an analyst must examine a suspect's DOS-based storage           (5)  
  media. How forensic tools and commands in DOS can be used to retrieve hidden or deleted files.  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Analyze how Write Blockers (hardware tools) help maintain the integrity of evidence during forensic (5)  
  data acquisition. Provide an example of their use in real-world investigations.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
4)                A forensic examiner needs to verify the authenticity of acquired evidence. Analyze how hash             (5)  
  algorithms like MD5 or SHA-1 ensure reliable forensic data validation and maintain evidence  
  A)           integrity.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  B)           Define network forensics and describe how it helps in identifying and tracing malicious network         (5)  
  activities.  
  
  
  Page #1

Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
5)                       How ethical hacking helps organizations identify and prevent potential security threats.               (5)  
  
  
  A)                                                            Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)               Analyze how network scanning results help identify potential vulnerabilities and guide further         (5)  
  security testing.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Analysis"  
  
  
  -----End-----
